I was interviewing people the other night at the Kalshi event & asked a guy standing in the corner if he’d be down to answer a few quick questions.

He said no which was completely understandable.

I then asked why he was in Singapore & he replied with  “I’m a twitter KOL”.

I was like “nice man, so are you a trader or work with any of the projects here or what do you do?”

He coldly replied again “I’m a twitter KOL.”

I said “gotcha, so can I follow you or would I have heard of you?”

He was like “I’m a whale so yes, but no I won’t show you who I am.”

I was like “my bad bro! Looks like you’re way too important to connect with anyone here regardless just wanted to try and be nice. Hope you enjoy the rest of your time here!” and walked off.

Easily one of the douchiest people I’ve ever met at one of these events.

I completely understand not doxxing, but if you’re making the effort to attend any of these events, make the effort to be a decent human.

You’re not who you think you are, and you never know who you’re talking to.
